notes.title: New Name, New Look – Same Epic Battle!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!


We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we’re excited to share a big update:

Thrud – Valkyrie Rising is now called Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök!


Alongside the new name, we’ve also updated the game’s key art to better reflect horde-like gameplay and Norse atmosphere that define the experience. Our goal is to make it immediately clear what the game is all about — defending Asgard from unending hordes in a battle worthy of the gods.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558431/86f68daf07ae96af4863149b7128cab14f1bcb23.png"]


But Don't Worry - Thrud is still here!


You’ll continue your journey as the fierce Valkyrie Thrud, standing strong against the hordes of Ragnarök.



We hope you love the new direction as much as we do. Let us know what you think — your feedback continues to shape this world we're building together.



See you in Asgard, warriors!
